title: OSS IQ project config
description: The .ossiq.yaml a project commits next to its manifest.

version.description: The schema version of this file.

upgrade.description: Defaults for `ossiq upgrade start`. A flag on the command line beats them.

limit.description: Queue only the first N steps.

test-command.description: Shell command that checks the project. It runs once before the first step and after every applied step.

policy.description: Rules for the releases OSS IQ may recommend. A rule is off unless its block is present.

cooldown.description: Hold back releases younger than this. A flag, an environment variable or the user config beats it.

build.description: Build evidence the registry records for a release, checked on direct and transitive packages.

minimum.description: The weakest build tier a release may carry.

no-downgrade.description: Refuse a release with less build evidence than an earlier one of its major line.

source.description: How the default branch of a direct dependency's GitHub repository is protected.

minimum.description: The weakest source level a repository may have.

exceptions.description: Waivers. Each lifts the named rules for the releases it matches.

package.description: A registry name, or a glob over names such as @myorg/*.

versions.description: Exact versions it covers, quoted so YAML keeps them strings. Omit for every version.

rules.description: The rules it lifts. Omit for all of them.

expires.description: The last day it holds, as YYYY-MM-DD. After it the rules apply again.
